name: Azekah
overview: Azekah was a strategically important town in the territory of Judah, noted in Scripture as a site of significant military engagements and divine intervention. It is mentioned as a location where the LORD granted Israel victory over their enemies, notably during the battle recounted in Joshua 10, where God sent hailstones to defeat the fleeing enemy near Azekah. The town is also identified as one of the defended cities of Judah during the Babylonian siege, emphasizing its role as a key stronghold in Judah's defense. Throughout the biblical narrative, Azekah stands as a reminder of God's providential protection over His people and His sovereignty in the affairs of nations.
